text: jsejrh30 lists the components consumed by c4s-plugin-code-snippets as popover, badge, form-field, action-button, loading-state, but no source of the package imports anything from @c4s/plugin-runtime/ui: its popover, badge, copy/maximise buttons and loading state are own markup. The unit goal does not ask for this migration, so nothing was rebuilt and no test claims the consumption. Needs: either the slice's consumed list reflects the current state (none, with the own markup as DŁUG entries) or a later unit migrates the package onto the catalog.
